task: bounded-Holevo approximate broadcasting to entanglement-breaking lift; focused operator-order lemma audit

claims.statement: Every unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint qubit CPTP map Phi with a two-output CPTP extension whose two marginals equal Phi admits an entanglement-breaking unital channel Psi satisfying I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi) in Hilbert-Schmidt operator order.
claims.quantifiers: All qubit channels satisfying the stated assumptions; one common Psi is constructed from the eigenbasis of Phi.
claims.costs: Dimension exactly 2; exact algebra only; no numerical solver, asymptotic loss, or hidden dimension factor.
claims.proof_core: Diagonalize the real symmetric Bloch matrix by one unitary. The symmetric Choi extension implies every Bell eigenvalue p_k <= 3/4, since the two Bell projectors on R-B1 and R-B2 have overlap norm 1/2 and sum norm 3/2. With lambda_i the Bloch eigenvalues, set nu_i=(2 lambda_i-1)_+. Bell eigenvalue formulas imply sum_i nu_i<=1 by separate cases of 0,1,2,3 active coordinates. The mixture (1-sum nu_i) Delta_0 + sum nu_i Delta_i is EB and has Bloch eigenvalues nu_i; coordinatewise 1-nu_i<=2(1-lambda_i).
claims.assumption_caveat: The proof does not need lambda_i>=0. If positive in the parent target means positive semidefinite as a Hilbert-Schmidt superoperator, this theorem still applies to that smaller subclass. Unitality and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjointness are needed for the no-translation symmetric Bloch diagonalization.
claims.falsifier: A concrete unital self-adjoint qubit self-compatible CPTP map for which the constructed comparator fails would falsify the derivation; independently, a claimed min factor above 2 in this class would contradict the explicit comparator.
claims.novelty_boundary: This finite-dimensional proof is not an unrestricted dimension-free operator lemma and does not imply the bounded-Holevo family theorem. External priority and independent review are unverified.

claims.statement: For fixed input dimension d and an n-output symmetric broadcaster, a marginal admits an EB approximation with a bound scaling as 3[((ln 2)d^6 log_2 d)/(n delta^3)]^(1/3) on the diamond norm for at least n(1-delta) outputs.
claims.quantifiers: Any CPTP Lambda:A->A_1...A_n, 0<delta<1; one POVM on A and a subset of at least n(1-delta) marginal indices.
claims.costs: Explicit dependence d^6 log d, n^-1/3 delta^-1; for symmetric channels a fixed delta such as 1/2 yields the common marginal conclusion as n grows.
claims.source: Xie, Fang, Wang, Duan, Approximate broadcasting of quantum correlations, Lemma 3, arXiv:1705.06071.
claims.boundary: Many-copy channel approximation; it does not convert small two-copy error on a state family with growing dimension into a dimension-free familywise EB reconstruction.

claims.statement: A k-Bose-symmetric-extendible channel has an EB channel whose worst-case reference-assisted trace-distance error is at most |B|/k; separately, for one supplied bipartite state, measurement-recovery EB fidelity is at least 2^(-D(A:underline B)/2).
claims.quantifiers: First: fixed finite B, any k-Bose-symmetric extendible channel. Second: one fixed finite-dimensional rho_AB and its measurement discord.
claims.costs: First bound depends linearly on output dimension and inversely on copy count. Second is state-dependent and fidelity-valued.
claims.boundary: Neither result gives an EB Dirichlet-order comparator from only 2-compatibility in arbitrary dimension or the bounded-Holevo approximate-family implication.

claims.statement: For varying finite-dimensional families E_n, uniformly bounded Holevo capacity and b_2(E_n)->0 imply e_EB(E_n)->0 with a dimension-free modulus.
claims.quantifiers: All sequences of finite-dimensional state families, with dimensions and family sizes allowed to grow; one EB reconstruction per family, evaluated uniformly on that family.
claims.costs: No general modulus, proof, or qualifying counterexample established in the reviewed evidence.
claims.source: Pinned internal N93 bounded-holevo-gates card; N46/N61/N67/N69 are prior boundaries.
claims.attack: Use a general dimension-free positive tracial self-adjoint self-compatible Phi-to-EB Dirichlet comparison or another common-measurement/variance route; the exact qubit proof only handles d=2.

review_limits.proof_review: No independent external review of the new qubit derivation.
review_limits.experiments: No numerical SDP was run; the qubit theorem is proved algebraically in REPORT.md.
review_limits.external_priority: Not assessed beyond the cited primary-source audit.
